name: Manual Trigger — Dependency Upgrade Workflow (WF3)
description: Manually triggers the WF3 Dependency Upgrade workflow to upgrade outdated third-party dependencies

then.prompt: Execute the WF3 Dependency Upgrade workflow. Follow the wf3-dependency-upgrades skill steps exactly: 1) Create a restore point using git-rollback MCP create_restore_point. 2) Scan for outdated dependencies using dependency-scanner MCP scan_outdated. 3) Check compatibility for each outdated dependency using dependency-scanner MCP check_compatibility. 4) Generate code updates to resolve any breaking changes. 5) Run the full automated test suite against updated dependencies. 6) Generate a delta report listing each upgraded dependency, version changes, breaking changes, code modifications, and test results. 7) Log all results to audit-logger MCP. If tests fail after upgrades, halt and report failures. Provide rollback capability via git-rollback MCP.
